evidence: The ALD experiments were carried out in a SUNALE TM R-150 ALD reactor by Picosun. Trimethylaluminum AlMe3 was used as aluminum source, titanium tetrachloride TiCl4 as titanium source and deionized water H 2O as oxygen source. Standard recipes consisted of constant 200 sccm nitrogen flows through each of the three reactant lines, and pulse times of 0.1 s and purge times of 4 s.
